speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
text: asked	the Minister for Finance (a) what is the expected impact of automation on our Civil Service in the next five years; (b) what has been the progress of automation in our Ministries, Statutory Boards and Government agencies so far; and (b) what is the estimated increase in productivity.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: As an example, in 1998, the National Library Board (NLB) was the first in the world to use radio-frequency identification to track its books.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: It is now using AutoSorters to reduce the manual effort needed to sort returned books.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: Another example would be the use of drones.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: Automation is also helping the Public Service to enhance our service delivery standards and provide greater convenience to customers.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: Citizens can expect to see more automation that will benefit them in the years to come.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: The Ministry of Transport and LTA are working with partners from academia and industry to trial various self-driving vehicle technologies and concepts.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: In time to come, self-driving shuttles can be deployed in neighbourhoods to bring commuters from their homes to the train station, thereby improving first- and last-mile connectivity.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: Ongoing initiatives to trial self-driving buses, truck platooning and autonomous utility vehicles can alleviate the shortage of drivers.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: It is difficult to come up with a single measure of productivity increase in the Public Service.
